name: abracadabrax-ai-wallpaper-maker-v2
description: Create a wallpaper from a theme and a style, sized for phone, desktop, tablet or a square screen with space kept clear for icons and the clock, rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Describe a theme and a style and get a wallpaper sized for your screen: phone (9:16), desktop (16:9), tablet (4:3) or square.

The plugin composes the image with space kept clear for the clock and the app icons, prepares a draft with the format and the image model, and when you confirm Abracadabrax renders it and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For anyone who wants a background that is theirs.

Limitations: new wallpapers from text only. It does not resize, crop or restyle your own photos. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: A misty mountain lake at sunrise, photorealistic, phone wallpaper
Abstract liquid gradients in deep blue and purple for my desktop
A cozy rainy city street at night, anime landscape, tablet

positive.prompt: A misty mountain lake at sunrise, photorealistic, for my phone. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft in the phone format (9:16) with the style and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: Abstract liquid gradients in deep blue and purple, minimal, for my desktop. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft in the desktop format (16:9) with the colors and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A cozy rainy city street at night, anime landscape, for my tablet. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft in the tablet format (4:3) and the image model. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A minimal phone wallpaper of a lone tree on a hill under a starry sky, deep blue. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account; get_media_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute image URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: A watercolor wallpaper of cherry blossoms for my phone. Prepare it, then make it for my desktop instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_wallpaper, then update_media_project or prepare_wallpaper again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the desktop format, either updated or prepared again. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Crop this photo of my dog to fit my iPhone lock screen.
Set this picture as the wallpaper on my phone.
Make an animated live wallpaper with falling snow that moves.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing runs in the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the image link back in the conversation.
